title: Be Aware
body:
This App helps you remember to do the stuff you acknowledge is important to you, stop procrastinating and have an App to help you. 

You will excel at your goals, being them: exercise, stretch, follow your diet, meditate, drink water, floss your teeth.... anything you need to do on a daily basis. Being aware helps you being consistent.
